title.narrative: Fish Farming Value Chain Development project in Burundi

description.narrative: This project will contribute to improved livelihoods and higher food security of the rural population in Burundi.This project will develop fish farming as a new profitable value chain in Burundi, in cooperation with local communities and based on sound natural resource management. The project will develop 80 fish farm cooperatives with 50 fish farmers each, thus resulting in 4,000 new fish farmers.
